items.parse_summary: The question asks which action is characterized as the sin attributed to Jeroboam’s family. Its passive construction leaves the source of that characterization implicit. The choices are short action phrases; option C has an implicit actor, Jeroboam, with “anyone” receiving appointment to the role of priest. Understanding the attribution requires connecting the passage’s “house of Jeroboam” with his preceding action.

features.required_operations: Identify Jeroboam as the implicit actor, “anyone” as the person consecrated, and “priest” as the resulting role; distinguish his action from the family to which the sin is attributed.
features.reason: These participant relationships express the intended action and its attribution without additional embedded clauses or competing role assignments.
